children: MiniMed Group, Inc. reported results for 2026 with revenue of $843M, up from $723M a year earlier, and diluted earnings per share of $0 versus ($0.08) in the prior-year quarter, as the company returned to break-even net income.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Earnings (loss) per share”.
Revenue growth of 16.6% year-over-year was driven in part by a higher share of continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) attachments, with CGM penetration at about 69%.
Product launches and regulatory progress included MiniMed Go in the EU and U.S., U.S. launch of MiniMed Flex with Instinct/Simplera, CE mark for Flex and an FDA submission for Fit.
Operational scaling — including expanded Simplera supply and broader Instinct rollout — supported higher pump and consumable volumes globally.
Management continued to invest in R&D, commercialization and IT to support new product commercialization and future growth.
